text:
To sell 1 car, Jason needs 2 customers to visit the dealership.
To get 1 customer to visit, he needs to make 25 phone calls.
Therefore, selling 1 car requires:
$2 \text{ customers} \times 25 \text{ calls/customer} = 50 \text{ calls}$

To sell 15 cars, he needs:
$15 \times 50 = 750 \text{ calls}$

ANSWER: 750
